definitions.ask: Should Ctrl-G U set the whole line to one case (UPPER, else lower) instead of swapping each letter?
definitions.why: The request names two states, upper and lower; undo restores the original

choices.label: A mixed line goes UPPER, then lower; only Command-Z restores its original mixed case
Per-letter swap like Vim g~~; pressing twice restores the line, but Hello becomes hELLO

definitions.ask: Should an unbound key pressed right after Ctrl-G be swallowed with a beep instead of acting normally?
definitions.why: Usual prefix-key behavior (Emacs, tmux); a mistyped chord never types into the draft

choices.label: The key is consumed with a beep, so a mistyped chord never edits the draft
The leader cancels silently and the key acts exactly as if Ctrl-G had never been pressed

definitions.ask: Should the footer status line show a pending-chord hint while Ctrl-G waits for its next key?
definitions.why: Without a hint, a stray Ctrl-G silently changes what the next key does.

choices.label: The footer status reads "⌃G · U toggle line case · esc cancel" until the next key
No visual change; nothing shows that the next key is captured
